meta.source: NVIDIA Green #76b900 and Dark Gray #1e1e1e: NVIDIA Trademark and Logo Usage Guidelines (2019 PDF). Rockwell red #cd163f: third-party sites only (brandcolorcode.com, brandfetch.com), not verified with Rockwell.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Slide and page background. Dark = NVIDIA Dark Gray (official).

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, chart plot area, placeholder boxes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text on surface-100 and surface-200. Also text on nvidia-green.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, source lines, placeholder text, chart tick labels.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, table borders, chart gridlines. Never text.

tokens.name: nvidia-green
tokens.usage: NVIDIA Green (official, PMS 376C ref.). Brand fill: cover blocks, accent bars, OUR METHOD in charts. Too light for text on white (2.4:1): put ink on it, or use green-text.

tokens.name: rockwell-red
tokens.usage: Rockwell Automation red (UNVERIFIED value from third-party sites). Brand fill: cover blocks, accent bars, CARRYOVER and misses in charts. White text on it passes (5.6:1).

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green for text and eyebrows. Light value is a darker tint we made from NVIDIA Green for contrast; it is not an NVIDIA colour.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Red for text: TODO labels, flagged-vial labels. Dark value is a lighter tint we made for contrast; it is not a Rockwell colour.

tokens.name: baseline
tokens.usage: Every baseline series in charts (first-vial rule, vision-only check, drainage-only model).

tokens.name: fluid-orange
tokens.usage: T-200 orange fluid. Vial and tank diagrams only, never UI or chart series.

tokens.name: fluid-blue
tokens.usage: T-400 blue fluid. Vial and tank diagrams only.

tokens.name: fluid-clear
tokens.usage: T-100 clear fluid and the empty part of a vial. Diagrams only, never text.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Title slide and section dividers only.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: One per slide. Say the point of the slide, not the topic.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and column headings inside a slide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The first vial after a recipe change holds residue from the old recipe.
styles.usage: Slide body text. Max about 25 words per block. Sizes are for the 1920 x 1080 slide canvas; never under 24px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Source lines under every number and chart, in ink-muted.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: One big measured number per slide, with its count and source below.

styles.name: label-mono
styles.usage: Eyebrows, evidence tags, tank names, vial IDs, axis titles. Upper case.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a number and its caption; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between items in a list or between chart and source line.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between columns and cards on a slide.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Slide outer margin on the 1920 x 1080 canvas.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Evidence tags, chart bars (top corners only).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, placeholder boxes, images.

tokens.name: radius-vial
tokens.usage: Vial shapes in diagrams and the cover: a pill whose radius is half its width.
